en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European village. In the foreground is a calm river crossed by a simple concrete bridge with metal railings, framed by trees and foliage. Beyond the bridge lie open grass and several modest houses with pitched roofs. In the distant background, a church tower with a pointed spire rises above the trees. The caption text is printed in white at the bottom edge of the image.
